::: {.home-hero}
::: {.home-hero-text}

Associate Professor of [Government](http://www.american.edu/spa/gov/), American University\
Associate Director, [Center for Data Science](https://www.american.edu/spa/data-science/), American University\
Senior Social Scientist, [The Lab @ DC](https://thelab.dc.gov)

I study statistical political methodology, with applications in American social policy — especially [experiments and experimental design](research.qmd), causal inference, ecological and geolocated data, and reproducible social science. I also write statistical [software](software.qmd) and [teach](teaching.qmd) at American University. More [below](#about).

## About

I have also been

- a long-time [EGAP](http://egap.org/) affiliate; 
- Visiting Scholar at the Institut Barcelona d’Estudis Internacionals ([IBEI](https://www.ibei.org), 2021-22); 
- Scholar in Health Policy Research at UC Berkeley/UCSF (2010–2012), funded by the Robert Wood Johnson Foundation;
- Fellow in Methodology with the federal Office of Evaluation Sciences ([OES](https://oes.gsa.gov), 2019-2025).
- Co-host of [SLAMM! 2016](events/slamm-2016.qmd) at American University
- Doctoral fellow at Harvard's [Inequality and Social Policy](http://inequality.hks.harvard.edu/) program;
- Graduate associate of the Institute for Quantitative Social Science ([IQSS](http://www.iq.harvard.edu)).
:::
